/-!
# Rational-point residue bridge for the translated cover

The density oracle used by the translated-cover drop has to record residue degree one at the
chosen points.  This file supplies that arithmetic bridge from the actual section certificate,
rather than adding `residueDeg = 1` as an unrelated existential field.  The relative specialization
is the exact point produced by `Over.rationalPointBaseChange`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
open TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

/-! ## Sections have residue degree one -/

theorem residueDeg_one_of_section
    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X.left}
    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    {x : X.left}
    (hx : e.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x) :
    X.left.residueDeg K x = 1 := by
  letI : Algebra K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := stalkAlgebra X.hom x
  have h := bijective_algebraMap_residueField_of_section X he hx
  have hmap :
      algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
        X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x := by
    ext c
    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)),
      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap,
      algebraMap_overStalkAlgebra]
    simp [stalkStructureHom, Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    rfl
  letI : Algebra K (X.left.residueField x) :=
    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toAlgebra
  unfold Scheme.residueDeg
  change Module.finrank K (X.left.residueField x) = 1
  apply Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap
  change Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x)
  rw [← hmap]
  exact h

/-! ## The base-changed rational point is such a section -/

theorem residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
    (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :
    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L
      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L)) = 1 := by
  apply residueDeg_one_of_section
    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k L)).left)
    (e := Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp)
  · exact Over.rationalPointBaseChange_snd C L p hp
  · rfl

/-- The graph point of a field-valued point has residue degree one. -/
theorem residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.residueDeg K (Over.graphPoint C t) = 1 := by
  exact residueDeg_one_of_section
    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
    (e := (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left)
    (by
      exact congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k K => q.left)
        (Over.sectionOfPoint_snd t))
    (by
      change (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) =
        (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base default
      exact congrArg (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base
        (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

/-- The graph presentation has multiplicity one at its graph point.

`presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations` initially records the multiplicity as an order.
The graph class and its residue field both have degree one, so the degree formula forces that
order to be one.  This is the pointwise input for finite-support class descent below. -/
theorem graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    Over.graphPicClass C t =
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single (graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t) 1) := by
  let hx := graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t
  let a : ℤ :=
    Multiplicative.toAdd
      (Scheme.ordZ ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
        hx ((Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation.elem (Over.graphPoint C t)))
  have hsingle :
      Scheme.presentationDivisor K (Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation =
        Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a := by
    exact presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations C t
  have hclass :
      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a) =
        Over.graphPicClass C t := by
    rw [← hsingle, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor K,
      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
    rfl
  have hdeg := classDeg_graphPicClass C t
  rw [← hclass, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single'] at hdeg
  rw [residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint C t, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hdeg
  rw [hdeg] at hclass
  exact hclass.symm

/-! ## Image-set packaging -/

theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChange_image
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    (P : Set (relCurve C L))
    (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x) :
    ∀ x ∈ P, (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hP x hx
  rw [← hpx]
  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp

/-! ## The dense point image used by the drop oracle -/

/-- The points obtained by base-changing actual `k`-rational sections of `C` to `L`.

The section certificate is retained in the membership predicate, so later consumers can recover
the base point and its exact residue-degree proof.  This is deliberately an image set, rather
than an existential carrier unrelated to the chosen curve and extension. -/
def rationalPointBaseChangeImage
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : Set (relCurve C L) :=
  {x | ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x}

/-- Base-changed `k`-rational points are dense over a separably closed base. -/
theorem dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
    (U : (relCurve C L).Opens)
    (hU : (U : Set (relCurve C L)).Nonempty) :
    (rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L ∩ U).Nonempty := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmem⟩ := Over.dense_baseChange_rationalPoints C L U hU
  exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hmem⟩⟩

/-- Every point in the dense image has residue degree one, by its retained section certificate. -/
theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage'
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
      (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
  rw [← hpx]
  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp

/-! ## Class descent for divisors supported on the rational-point image -/

/-- Every point in the rational-point image is non-generic.  The retained section certificate
identifies it with an actual graph point, where `graphPoint_ne_genericPoint` applies. -/
theorem ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
  rw [← hpx]
  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
    exact hp)
  change Over.graphPoint C
      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) ≠
        genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left
  exact graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C _

/-- The one-point divisor at a base-changed rational point is the base change of a class on the

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep

/-!
# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route

The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:

* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.

The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

variable (C n) in
/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
  naturality T T' g := by
    ext s
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm

@[simp]
lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
  rfl

variable (C n) in
/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)

@[simp]
lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
  rfl

variable (C) in
/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.

This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
be an open immersion. -/
def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

   124	/-- A native datum for the arbitrary-affine pullback of a split field class has the required
   125	residue-field `H¹` witnesses.
   126	
   127	This is a field-origin specialization, not a claim for an arbitrary affine Picard class.  The
   128	map to each residue field factors through the affine algebra and the chosen etale cover, so the
   129	single split witness over `K` supplies all pointwise witnesses needed by the datum. -/
   130	theorem PicRankOneNativeDatum.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback
   131	    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   132	    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
   133	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   134	    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
   135	    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   136	    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
   137	    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
   138	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
   139	      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField := by
   140	  apply P.residueH1Witness_of_isSplitWitness

   142	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=

   146	    IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier _
   147	  let phi : K →ₐ[k]

   152	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   153	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) :=
   154	    picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   155	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   156	  have hpoint : Over.testPoint t = Over.overSpecMap rho := by
   157	    rw [testPoint_eq_overSpecMap]

   161	      (Over.testPoint t ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) ≫ Over.overSpecMap e =
   162	        Over.overSpecMap phi := by
   163	    rw [Category.assoc, hpoint, ← Over.overSpecMap_comp, ← Over.overSpecMap_comp]
   164	  have hclass :
   165	      picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
   166	          (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   167	            (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) =
   168	        picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap phi) nu := by
   169	    calc
   170	      _ = picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t)
   171	          (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1) := by rw [hcover]
   172	      _ = picEtMap C
   173	          (Over.testPoint t ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 :=
   174	        (picEtMap_comp (C := C) (Over.overSpecMap iota)
   175	          (Over.testPoint t) lam.1).symm

   180	            Over.overSpecMap e) nu :=

   182	          (Over.testPoint t ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) nu).symm
   183	      _ = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap phi) nu :=
   184	        congrArg (fun f => picEtMap C f nu) hmaps
   185	  rw [hclass]
   186	  exact isSplitWitness_map_overSpecMap_of_algHom
   187	    (C := C) pi phi nu hsplit

    10	/-!
    11	# T3 — datum-section extraction from a class-matched divisor
    12	
    13	The converse of the DAT-A class law (`sectionLocalEquations_picClass`): a
    14	`Scheme.LocalEquations` divisor datum `d` whose Picard class is the Čech class of a pinned
    15	basic-open cocycle datum `D` is itself cut — up to `DivEq` — by a germ-regular global
    16	section of `D`'s glued sheaf.
    17	
    18	The construction is the α-corrected gluing: class equality unquotients (on a common
    19	refinement of `d.cover` and `D`'s canonical piece cover) to a `0`-cochain of units `α`
    20	conjugating `d`'s ratio-unit cocycle into `D`'s subordinated transition cocycle
    21	(`OneCocycle.class_eq_iff` + `isCohomologous_iff_evInf`).  The corrected local sections
    22	`α x · d.eqn x` then form a matching family for `D`'s transition units, i.e. a compatible
    23	family of sections of `D`'s glued sheaf through the piece trivializations (`gluedTriv`);
    24	the glued sheaf's own sheaf property (`gluedSheaf`, `TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'`)
    25	glues them to a global section.  Its components are unit multiples of `d`'s equations near
    26	every point, giving germ-regularity, and the divisor it cuts on any subordinated pointed
    27	cover is `DivEq` to `d` (`sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section` transports between
    28	covers).
    29	
    30	No Noetherian or finiteness hypothesis beyond the datum's own appears: the statement holds
    31	over an arbitrary test algebra `B`.
    32	-/
    33	
    34	set_option autoImplicit false
    35	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    36	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    37	
    38	universe u
    39	
    40	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite CategoryTheory.PresheafOfGroups
    41	
    42	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    43	
    44	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule
    45	
    46	namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
    47	
    48	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    49	variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
    50	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π]
    51	variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B π) (d : (relCurve C B).LocalEquations)
    52	
    53	/-- The underlying section of a restricted unit is the restriction of its underlying
    54	section. -/
    55	private lemma coe_unitsRestrict {X : Scheme.{u}} {W U : X.Opens} (h : W ≤ U)
    56	    (u : Γ(X, U)ˣ) :
    57	    ((X.unitsRestrict h u : Γ(X, W)ˣ) : Γ(X, W)) = X.resHom h (u : Γ(X, U)) :=
    58	  rfl
    59	
    60	/-! ## The α-corrected local sections and their matching law -/
    61	
    62	/-- The α-corrected local section over a member of the common refinement: the correcting
    63	unit times the restricted equation of `d`. -/
    64	private noncomputable def corrSection (𝒲₀ : (relCurve C B).PointedCover)
    65	    (hWd : 𝒲₀ ≤ d.cover) (α : ∀ x : relCurve C B, Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x)ˣ)
    66	    (x : relCurve C B) : Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x) :=
    67	  (α x : Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x)) * (relCurve C B).resHom (hWd x) (d.eqn x)
    68	
    69	/-- **The matching law of the corrected sections**: on the overlap of two refinement
    70	members, the corrected sections differ by the restricted transition unit of the datum —
    71	the coboundary law for `α` composed with the ratio law of `d`'s equations. -/
    72	private lemma corrSection_matching (𝒲₀ : (relCurve C B).PointedCover)
    73	    (hWd : 𝒲₀ ≤ d.cover)
    74	    (hσ₀ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x))
    75	    (α : ∀ x : relCurve C B, Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x)ˣ)
    76	    (hα : ∀ x y : relCurve C B,
    77	      (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (α x)
    78	          * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hWd x) (hWd y)) (d.ratioUnit x y)
    79	        = gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀ x y
    80	          * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α y))
    81	    (x y : relCurve C B) :
    82	    (relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_left : 𝒲₀.opens x ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ 𝒲₀.opens x)
    83	        (corrSection d 𝒲₀ hWd α x)
    84	      = (relCurve C B).resHom
    85	          (le_inf (inf_le_left.trans (hσ₀ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ₀ y)) :
    86	            𝒲₀.opens x ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y
    87	              ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex y))
    88	          (D.unit (D.pieceIndex x) (D.pieceIndex y) :
    89	            Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex y)))
    90	        * (relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_right : 𝒲₀.opens x ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ 𝒲₀.opens y)
    91	            (corrSection d 𝒲₀ hWd α y) := by
    92	  -- the ratio law of `d`, retyped in `resHom` form and restricted to the overlap
    93	  have hbase : (relCurve C B).resHom
    94	      (inf_le_left : d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens y ≤ d.cover.opens x) (d.eqn x)
    95	      = (d.ratioUnit x y : Γ(relCurve C B, d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens y))
    96	        * (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right (d.eqn y) := d.eqn_restrict_eq x y
    97	  have hratio := congrArg
    98	    ((relCurve C B).resHom (inf_le_inf (hWd x) (hWd y) :
    99	      𝒲₀.opens x ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ d.cover.opens x ⊓ d.cover.opens y)) hbase
   100	  rw [map_mul] at hratio
   101	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hratio
   102	  -- the value form of the coboundary law
   103	  have hval := congrArg Units.val (hα x y)
   104	  rw [Units.val_mul, Units.val_mul, gluedSubordUnit] at hval
   105	  simp only [coe_unitsRestrict] at hval
   106	  -- assemble
   107	  simp only [corrSection, map_mul, Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   108	  rw [hratio, ← mul_assoc, hval, mul_assoc]
   109	
   110	/-! ## The main extraction theorem -/
   111	
   112	/-- **Datum-section extraction from a class-matched divisor** (T3, the heart of the
   113	rank-one uniqueness discharge): a `LocalEquations` divisor datum whose Picard class is the
   114	Čech class of the pinned cocycle datum is cut, up to `DivEq` on every subordinated pointed
   115	cover, by a germ-regular global section of the datum's glued sheaf. -/
   116	theorem exists_gluedSection_sectionLocalEquations_divEq
   117	    (h : d.picClass = D.cechPicClass) :
   118	    ∃ (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   119	      (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
   120	        ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
   121	          ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y)),
   122	      ∀ (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
   123	        (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x)),
   124	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg) d := by
   125	  classical
   126	  -- Step 1: common refinement of the two covers computing the classes
   127	  have h' : Scheme.CechPic.mk d.cover d.unitsCocycle.class
   128	      = Scheme.CechPic.mk D.pointedCover
   129	          (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   130	            fun _ => le_rfl).class := h
   131	  obtain ⟨𝒲₀, hWd, hWD, e⟩ := Scheme.CechPic.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp h'
   132	  have hσ₀ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x ≤ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex x) :=
   133	    fun x => hWD x
   134	  -- Step 2: the restricted cocycles are cohomologous
   135	  have e' : (d.unitsCocycle.res fun p => homOfLE (hWd p)).IsCohomologous
   136	      (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀) := by
   137	    rw [← OneCocycle.class_eq_iff]
   138	    calc (d.unitsCocycle.res fun p => homOfLE (hWd p)).class
   139	        = Scheme.unitsRes hWd d.unitsCocycle.class := rfl
   140	      _ = Scheme.unitsRes hWD (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover
   141	            D.pieceIndex fun _ => le_rfl).class := e
   142	      _ = ((gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle D.pointedCover D.pieceIndex
   143	            fun _ => le_rfl).res fun p => homOfLE (hWD p)).class := rfl
   144	      _ = (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀).class := by
   145	            rw [gluedSubordCocycle_res]
   146	  -- Step 3: extract the correcting 0-cochain of units
   147	  obtain ⟨α, hα₀⟩ := (OneCocycle.isCohomologous_iff_evInf _ _).mp e'
   148	  have hα : ∀ x y : relCurve C B,
   149	      (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (α x)
   150	          * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict (inf_le_inf (hWd x) (hWd y)) (d.ratioUnit x y)
   151	        = gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀ x y
   152	          * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α y) := by
   153	    intro x y
   154	    have key : (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (α x)
   155	        * Scheme.unitsEvInf (d.unitsCocycle.res fun p => homOfLE (hWd p)) x y
   156	      = Scheme.unitsEvInf
   157	          (gluedSubordCocycle D.isGluingCocycle 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀) x y
   158	        * (relCurve C B).unitsRestrict inf_le_right (α y) := hα₀ x y
   159	    rwa [Scheme.res_unitsEvInf, d.unitsCocycle_evInf, gluedSubordCocycle_evInf] at key
   160	  -- Step 4: the corrected sections are a compatible family of glued-sheaf sections
   161	  set sf : ∀ x : relCurve C B, ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit (𝒲₀.opens x)) :=
   162	    fun x => (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex x) (hσ₀ x)).symm
   163	      (corrSection d 𝒲₀ hWd α x) with hsf
   164	  have hcompat : ∀ x y : relCurve C B,
   165	      gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit
   166	          (inf_le_left : 𝒲₀.opens x ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ 𝒲₀.opens x) (sf x)
   167	        = gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit inf_le_right (sf y) := by
   168	    intro x y
   169	    apply (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex x)
   170	      (inf_le_left.trans (hσ₀ x))).injective
   171	    rw [gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex x) inf_le_left (hσ₀ x) (sf x),
   172	      hsf]
   173	    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   174	    rw [gluedTriv_eq_unit_mul B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex x) (D.pieceIndex y)
   175	        (inf_le_left.trans (hσ₀ x)) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ₀ y)),
   176	      gluedTriv_res B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex y) inf_le_right (hσ₀ y)]
   177	    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   178	    exact D.corrSection_matching d 𝒲₀ hWd hσ₀ α hα x y
   179	  -- Step 5: glue by the sheaf property of the glued sheaf
   180	  have hcov : (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens) ≤ ⨆ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲₀.opens x :=
   181	    fun p _ => Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨p, 𝒲₀.mem_opens p⟩
   182	  obtain ⟨s, hs, -⟩ := TopCat.Sheaf.existsUnique_gluing'
   183	    (gluedSheaf B D.pieces D.unit) (fun x => 𝒲₀.opens x) ⊤
   184	    (fun x => homOfLE le_top) hcov sf (fun x y => hcompat x y)
   185	  have hs' : ∀ x : relCurve C B,
   186	      gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit (le_top : 𝒲₀.opens x ≤ ⊤) s = sf x :=
   187	    fun x => hs x
   188	  -- Step 6: the component over each refinement member is the corrected section
   189	  have heqn : ∀ x : relCurve C B,
   190	      (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ₀ x) (D.component s (D.pieceIndex x))
   191	        = corrSection d 𝒲₀ hWd α x := by
   192	    intro x
   193	    have h2 := congrArg
   194	      (gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex x) (hσ₀ x)) (hs' x)
   195	    rw [hsf] at h2
   196	    simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h2
   197	    calc (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ₀ x) (D.component s (D.pieceIndex x))
   198	        = (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ₀ x)
   199	            ((relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl)
   200	              (s.val (D.pieceIndex x))) := rfl
   201	      _ = gluedTriv B D.isGluingCocycle (D.pieceIndex x) (hσ₀ x)
   202	            (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit le_top s) := by
   203	          rw [gluedTriv_apply, gluedRes_coe]
   204	          simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   205	      _ = corrSection d 𝒲₀ hWd α x := h2
   206	  -- Step 7: germ-regularity of the glued section's components
   207	  have hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
   208	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
   209	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y) := by
   210	    intro j y hy
   211	    have hyO : y ∈ D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y := ⟨hy, 𝒲₀.mem_opens y⟩
   212	    -- the component near `y`, through the matching relation and the corrected section
   213	    have hO : D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y
   214	        ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex y) :=
   215	      le_inf (le_inf le_top inf_le_left) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ₀ y))
   216	    have hmatch := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom hO) (s.property j (D.pieceIndex y))
   217	    rw [map_mul] at hmatch
   218	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at hmatch
   219	    have hcomp1 : D.component s j
   220	        = (relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl) (s.val j) := rfl
   221	    have hcomp2 : D.component s (D.pieceIndex y)
   222	        = (relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl) (s.val (D.pieceIndex y)) := rfl
   223	    have h2 := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom
   224	      (inf_le_right : D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ 𝒲₀.opens y)) (heqn y)
   225	    rw [hcomp2] at h2
   226	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at h2
   227	    have hkey : (relCurve C B).resHom
   228	        (inf_le_left : D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ D.pieces j) (D.component s j)
   229	        = (relCurve C B).resHom (hO.trans (gluedInclCoc D.pieces ⊤ j (D.pieceIndex y)))
   230	            (D.unit j (D.pieceIndex y) :
   231	              Γ(relCurve C B, D.pieces j ⊓ D.pieces (D.pieceIndex y)))
   232	          * (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right (corrSection d 𝒲₀ hWd α y) := by
   233	      rw [hcomp1]
   234	      simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   235	      rw [← h2]
   236	      exact hmatch
   237	    have hgerm : ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
   238	        = ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y) y hyO).hom
   239	            ((relCurve C B).resHom
   240	              (inf_le_left : D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ D.pieces j)
   241	              (D.component s j)) := by
   242	      rw [Scheme.resHom, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
   243	    rw [hgerm, hkey, map_mul]
   244	    refine mul_mem ?_ ?_
   245	    · exact (((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
   246	        (hO.trans (gluedInclCoc D.pieces ⊤ j (D.pieceIndex y)))
   247	        (D.unit j (D.pieceIndex y))).isUnit.map
   248	          ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y) y
   249	            hyO).hom).mem_nonZeroDivisors
   250	    · rw [corrSection, map_mul, map_mul]
   251	      simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom]
   252	      refine mul_mem ?_ ?_
   253	      · exact (((relCurve C B).unitsRestrict
   254	          (inf_le_right : D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ 𝒲₀.opens y) (α y)).isUnit.map
   255	            ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y) y
   256	              hyO).hom).mem_nonZeroDivisors
   257	      · have hmem : ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y) y
   258	            hyO).hom ((relCurve C B).resHom
   259	              ((inf_le_right : D.pieces j ⊓ 𝒲₀.opens y ≤ 𝒲₀.opens y).trans (hWd y))
   260	              (d.eqn y))
   261	            = ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens y) y
   262	                ((hWd y) (𝒲₀.mem_opens y))).hom (d.eqn y) := by
   263	          rw [Scheme.resHom, TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply]
   264	        rw [hmem]
   265	        exact d.regular y y ((hWd y) (𝒲₀.mem_opens y))
   266	  -- Step 8: the divisor cut on the refinement cover is `DivEq` to `d`
   267	  have hdiv0 : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
   268	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀ hreg) d := by
   269	    refine ⟨𝒲₀, fun x => le_rfl, hWd, fun x => ⟨α x, ?_⟩⟩
   270	    have hL : ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE
   271	        (le_rfl : 𝒲₀.opens x ≤ 𝒲₀.opens x)).op).hom
   272	          ((D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲₀ D.pieceIndex hσ₀ hreg).eqn x)
   273	        = (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ₀ x) (D.component s (D.pieceIndex x)) := by
   274	      rw [sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
   275	      exact Scheme.resHom_self _ _
   276	    exact hL.trans (heqn x)
   277	  -- Conclusion: transport to every subordinated cover
   278	  exact ⟨s, hreg, fun 𝒲 σ hσ =>
   279	    (D.sectionLocalEquations_divEq_of_same_section s 𝒲 𝒲₀ σ D.pieceIndex hσ hσ₀
   280	      hreg).trans hdiv0⟩

   282	/-! ## Unit rescaling of the glued section -/
   283	
   284	/-- The `j`-th component of a scalar multiple of a glued section is the scalar multiple
   285	of the component. -/
   286	lemma component_smul (v : B) (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   287	    (j : D.index) :
   288	    D.component (v • s) j = v • D.component s j := by
   289	  unfold BasicOpenCocycleDatum.component
   290	  change (relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl) (v • s.val j)
   291	    = v • (relCurve C B).resHom (le_inf le_top le_rfl) (s.val j)
   292	  rw [Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def]
   293	  congr 1
   294	  exact (relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap_apply_res B (homOfLE (le_inf le_top le_rfl)).op v
   295	
   296	/-- Germ-regularity of the components transfers to unit multiples of a glued section. -/
   297	lemma germ_component_smul_mem_nonZeroDivisors (v : Bˣ)
   298	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   299	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
   300	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
   301	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y))
   302	    (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j) :
   303	    ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom
   304	        (D.component ((v : B) • s) j)
   305	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y) := by
   306	  rw [D.component_smul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul]
   307	  exact mul_mem
   308	    ((v.isUnit.map ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (D.pieces j))).map
   309	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom).mem_nonZeroDivisors
   310	    (hreg j y hy)
   311	
   312	/-- **Unit rescaling of the glued section does not change the cut divisor** (up to
   313	`DivEq`, on any subordinated pointed cover, over an arbitrary test algebra): scaling the
   314	glued section by a global unit of `B` multiplies each local equation by the image of the
   315	unit in the section ring — a unit rescaling of the local-equation system. -/
   316	theorem sectionLocalEquations_smul_divEq (v : Bˣ)
   317	    (s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤))
   318	    (𝒲 : (relCurve C B).PointedCover) (σ : relCurve C B → D.index)
   319	    (hσ : ∀ x : relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x ≤ D.pieces (σ x))
   320	    (hreg : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
   321	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom (D.component s j)
   322	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y))
   323	    (hreg' : ∀ (j : D.index) (y : relCurve C B) (hy : y ∈ D.pieces j),
   324	      ((relCurve C B).presheaf.germ (D.pieces j) y hy).hom
   325	          (D.component ((v : B) • s) j)
   326	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C B).presheaf.stalk y)) :
   327	    Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq
   328	      (D.sectionLocalEquations ((v : B) • s) 𝒲 σ hσ hreg')
   329	      (D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg) := by
   330	  refine ⟨𝒲, fun x => le_rfl, fun x => le_rfl, fun x => ?_⟩
   331	  refine ⟨Units.map ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (𝒲.opens x)).toMonoidHom v, ?_⟩
   332	  have hL : ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE
   333	      (le_rfl : 𝒲.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom
   334	        ((D.sectionLocalEquations ((v : B) • s) 𝒲 σ hσ hreg').eqn x)
   335	      = (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component ((v : B) • s) (σ x)) := by
   336	    rw [sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
   337	    exact Scheme.resHom_self _ _
   338	  have hR : ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE
   339	      (le_rfl : 𝒲.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom
   340	        ((D.sectionLocalEquations s 𝒲 σ hσ hreg).eqn x)
   341	      = (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component s (σ x)) := by
   342	    rw [sectionLocalEquations_eqn]
   343	    exact Scheme.resHom_self _ _
   344	  have hmain : (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component ((v : B) • s) (σ x))
   345	      = ((Units.map ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (𝒲.opens x)).toMonoidHom v :
   346	            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x)ˣ) : Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x))
   347	        * (relCurve C B).resHom (hσ x) (D.component s (σ x)) := by
   348	    rw [D.component_smul, Scheme.overModule_smul_def, map_mul]
   349	    congr 1
   350	    exact (relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap_apply_res B (homOfLE (hσ x)).op (v : B)
   351	  exact hL.trans (hmain.trans (congrArg
   352	    (((Units.map ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B (𝒲.opens x)).toMonoidHom v :
   353	        Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x)ˣ) : Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens x)) * ·) hR.symm))
   354

    12	/-!
    13	# Rational-point residue bridge for the translated cover
    14	
    15	The density oracle used by the translated-cover drop has to record residue degree one at the
    16	chosen points.  This file supplies that arithmetic bridge from the actual section certificate,
    17	rather than adding `residueDeg = 1` as an unrelated existential field.  The relative specialization
    18	is the exact point produced by `Over.rationalPointBaseChange`.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

    35	/-! ## Sections have residue degree one -/
    36	
    37	theorem residueDeg_one_of_section
    38	    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    39	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    40	    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X.left}
    41	    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    42	    {x : X.left}
    43	    (hx : e.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x) :
    44	    X.left.residueDeg K x = 1 := by
    45	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := stalkAlgebra X.hom x
    46	  have h := bijective_algebraMap_residueField_of_section X he hx
    47	  have hmap :
    48	      algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
    49	        X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x := by
    50	    ext c
    51	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    52	      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)),
    53	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap,
    54	      algebraMap_overStalkAlgebra]
    55	    simp [stalkStructureHom, Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    56	    rfl
    57	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.residueField x) :=
    58	    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toAlgebra
    59	  unfold Scheme.residueDeg
    60	  change Module.finrank K (X.left.residueField x) = 1
    61	  apply Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap
    62	  change Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x)
    63	  rw [← hmap]
    64	  exact h

    66	/-! ## The base-changed rational point is such a section -/
    67	
    68	theorem residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange
    69	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    70	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    71	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    72	    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
    73	    (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :
    74	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L
    75	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L)) = 1 := by
    76	  apply residueDeg_one_of_section
    77	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k L)).left)
    78	    (e := Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp)
    79	  · exact Over.rationalPointBaseChange_snd C L p hp
    80	  · rfl
    81	
    82	/-- The graph point of a field-valued point has residue degree one. -/
    83	theorem residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint
    84	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    85	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    86	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    87	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    88	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    89	    (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.residueDeg K (Over.graphPoint C t) = 1 := by
    90	  exact residueDeg_one_of_section
    91	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
    92	    (e := (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left)
    93	    (by
    94	      exact congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k K => q.left)
    95	        (Over.sectionOfPoint_snd t))
    96	    (by
    97	      change (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) =
    98	        (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base default
    99	      exact congrArg (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base
   100	        (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
   101	
   102	/-- The graph presentation has multiplicity one at its graph point.
   103	
   104	`presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations` initially records the multiplicity as an order.
   105	The graph class and its residue field both have degree one, so the degree formula forces that
   106	order to be one.  This is the pointwise input for finite-support class descent below. -/
   107	theorem graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single
   108	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   109	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   110	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   111	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   112	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   113	    Over.graphPicClass C t =
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
   115	        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single (graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t) 1) := by
   116	  let hx := graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t
   117	  let a : ℤ :=
   118	    Multiplicative.toAdd
   119	      (Scheme.ordZ ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   120	        hx ((Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation.elem (Over.graphPoint C t)))
   121	  have hsingle :
   122	      Scheme.presentationDivisor K (Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation =
   123	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a := by
   124	    exact presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations C t
   125	  have hclass :
   126	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a) =
   127	        Over.graphPicClass C t := by
   128	    rw [← hsingle, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor K,
   129	      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
   130	    rfl
   131	  have hdeg := classDeg_graphPicClass C t
   132	  rw [← hclass, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single'] at hdeg
   133	  rw [residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint C t, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hdeg
   134	  rw [hdeg] at hclass
   135	  exact hclass.symm

   137	/-! ## Image-set packaging -/
   138	
   139	theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChange_image
   140	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   141	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   142	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   143	    (P : Set (relCurve C L))
   144	    (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
   145	      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   146	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x) :
   147	    ∀ x ∈ P, (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
   148	  intro x hx
   149	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hP x hx
   150	  rw [← hpx]
   151	  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp

   153	/-! ## The dense point image used by the drop oracle -/
   154	
   155	/-- The points obtained by base-changing actual `k`-rational sections of `C` to `L`.
   156	
   157	The section certificate is retained in the membership predicate, so later consumers can recover
   158	the base point and its exact residue-degree proof.  This is deliberately an image set, rather
   159	than an existential carrier unrelated to the chosen curve and extension. -/
   160	def rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   161	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   162	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : Set (relCurve C L) :=
   163	  {x | ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
   164	      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   165	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base
   166	        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x}
   167	
   168	/-- Base-changed `k`-rational points are dense over a separably closed base. -/
   169	theorem dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   170	    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
   171	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   172	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   173	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
   174	    (U : (relCurve C L).Opens)
   175	    (hU : (U : Set (relCurve C L)).Nonempty) :
   176	    (rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L ∩ U).Nonempty := by
   177	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmem⟩ := Over.dense_baseChange_rationalPoints C L U hU
   178	  exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hmem⟩⟩
   179	
   180	/-- Every point in the dense image has residue degree one, by its retained section certificate. -/
   181	theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage'
   182	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   183	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   184	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   185	    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
   186	      (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
   187	  intro x hx
   188	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
   189	  rw [← hpx]
   190	  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp
   191	
   192	/-! ## Class descent for divisors supported on the rational-point image -/
   193	
   194	/-- Every point in the rational-point image is non-generic.  The retained section certificate
   195	identifies it with an actual graph point, where `graphPoint_ne_genericPoint` applies. -/
   196	theorem ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   197	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   198	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   199	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   200	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   201	    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
   202	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left := by
   203	  intro x hx
   204	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
   205	  rw [← hpx]
   206	  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
   207	    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
   208	    exact hp)
   209	  change Over.graphPoint C
   210	      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) ≠
   211	        genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left
   212	  exact graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C _
   213	
   214	/-- The one-point divisor at a base-changed rational point is the base change of a class on the
   215	base curve.  This is deliberately a class statement: no pullback operation on Weil divisors is
   216	needed. -/
   217	theorem exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   218	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   219	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   220	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   221	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   222	    (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   223	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   224	    (hmem : x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   225	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   226	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx 1) =
   227	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   228	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hmem
   229	  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
   230	    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
   231	    exact hp)
   232	  change Over.graphPoint C
   233	      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) = x at hpx
   234	  subst x
   235	  refine ⟨Over.graphPicClass C q, ?_⟩
   236	  rw [← graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single C]
   237	  exact graphPicClass_base_of_field C L q
   238	
   239	/-- A divisor whose finite support consists of base-changed rational points has a Picard class
   240	defined over the base field.
   241	
   242	The proof folds the pointwise graph-class identity over the divisor's `Finsupp` support.  It
   243	works for arbitrary integer multiplicities; effectivity and the prescribed drop degree are
   244	orthogonal hypotheses used by the greedy reduction, not by class descent. -/
   245	theorem exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   246	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   247	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   248	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   249	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   250	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   251	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   252	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   253	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   254	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   255	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   256	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   257	  suffices hmain : ∀ f : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   258	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left} →₀ ℤ,
   259	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   260	        (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   261	        coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) →
   262	      ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   263	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L f =
   264	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c from hmain S hsupp
   265	  intro f
   266	  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
   267	  | zero =>
   268	      intro _
   269	      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
   270	      change Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   271	        (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor) =
   272	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) 1
   273	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, map_one]
   274	      rfl
   275	  | single_add p b f hpf hb ih =>
   276	      intro hsupport
   277	      have hfp : f p = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hpf
   278	      have hpMem : p.1 ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   279	        apply hsupport p.1 p.2
   280	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) p ≠ 0
   281	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, hfp, add_zero]
   282	        exact hb
   283	      have hfSupport : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   284	          (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   285	          coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   286	        intro x hx hfx
   287	        apply hsupport x hx
   288	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) ⟨x, hx⟩ ≠ 0
   289	        have hxp : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {z : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   290	            z ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ≠ p := by
   291	          intro heq
   292	          subst p
   293	          exact hfx hfp
   294	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxp, zero_add]
   295	        exact hfx
   296	      obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ :=
   297	        exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   298	          C p.1 p.2 hpMem
   299	      have key : ∀ D : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor,
   300	          (∃ cf : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   301	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L D =
   302	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) cf) →
   303	          ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   304	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   305	              (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single p.2 b + D) =
   306	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   307	        intro D hD
   308	        obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hD
   309	        refine ⟨cp ^ b * cf, ?_⟩
   310	        unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hcp hcf ⊢
   311	        rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   312	          ← Scheme.picClass_single_zpow L p.2 b, hcp, hcf, map_mul, map_zpow]
   313	      exact key f (ih hfSupport)
   314	
   315	/-- Exact discharge of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData.baseSubtraction` for the rational-point
   316	image.  The descended class is re-presented by an actual base-field divisor `Z`; at exponent
   317	zero, the inverse of `chartTwistClass C 0 Z` is precisely `picClass k Z`. -/
   318	theorem exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   319	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   320	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   321	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   322	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   323	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   324	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   325	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   326	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   327	    ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   328	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   329	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   330	          ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹) := by
   331	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
   332	    exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C S hsupp
   333	  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := Scheme.CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq k c
   334	  refine ⟨Z, ?_⟩
   335	  rw [hc]
   336	  apply congrArg
   337	  simp only [chartTwistClass, pow_zero, one_mul]
   338	  rw [hZ]
   339	  exact (inv_inv c).symm
   340	
   341	/-! ## The separably-closed drop package -/
   342	
   343	section DropPackage
   344	
   345	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
   346	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   347	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   348	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   349	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   350	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
   351	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
   352	
   353	/-- Build the translated-drop package using the actual dense image of base-field rational
   354	points.  Density, non-genericity, residue degree one, and the base-subtraction class identity
   355	are derived here; only the lambda-tied positive-twist divisor and its degree/vanishing data
   356	remain inputs. -/
   357	noncomputable def sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   358	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   359	    (m : ℕ)
   360	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   361	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
   362	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   363	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   364	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   365	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   366	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   367	    (excess : ℕ)
   368	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   369	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   370	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   371	    SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ where
   372	  m := m
   373	  M₀ := M₀
   374	  hM₀ := hM₀
   375	  W₀ := W₀
   376	  hW₀ := hW₀
   377	  genusValue := genus C
   378	  excess := excess
   379	  hχ := chi_moduleKSheaf C
   380	  hdeg := hdeg
   381	  h1 := h1
   382	  P := rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   383	  hdense := dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   384	  hPcl := ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C
   385	  hPdeg := residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage' C L
   386	  baseSubtraction := by
   387	    intro S _ _ hsupp
   388	    exact exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C S hsupp
   389	
   390	/-- Immediate lambda-tied consumer of the rational-point-image package.
   391	
   392	The result contains the effective subtraction divisor, a base-field translating divisor,
   393	`h⁰ = 1`, preservation of `H¹ = 0`, the class-level base-change identity, and the existing
   394	`IsSplitWitness` for `μ` translated by that specific base-field class. -/
   395	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_of_rationalPointImage
   396	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   397	    (m : ℕ)
   398	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   399	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
   400	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   401	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   402	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   403	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   404	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   405	    (excess : ℕ)
   406	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   407	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   408	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   409	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ
   410	      (sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   411	        μ m M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ excess hdeg h1)) := by
   412	  exact exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult μ
   413	    (sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   414	      μ m M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ excess hdeg h1)
   415

    10	/-!
    11	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    12	
    13	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    14	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    15	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    16	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    17	
    18	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    19	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    20	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    22	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    27	
    28	universe u
    29	
    30	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    31	
    32	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    33	
    34	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    35	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    36	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    37	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    42	
    43	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    44	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    45	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    46	def PicRankOneOpen :
    47	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    48	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    49	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    50	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    51	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    52	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    53	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    54	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    55	      apply Subtype.ext
    56	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    57	    rw [e]
    58	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    59	
    60	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    61	
    62	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    63	
    64	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    65	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    66	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    67	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    68	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    69	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    70	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    71	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    72	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    73	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    74	
    75	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    76	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    77	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    78	contract. -/
    79	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    80	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    81	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    82	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    83	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    84	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    85	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    86	  rfl
    87	
    88	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    89	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    90	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    91	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    92	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    93	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    94	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    95	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    96	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    97	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    98	
    99	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
   100	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   101	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   102	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   103	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   104	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   105	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   106	
   107	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   108	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   109	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   110	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   111	
   112	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   113	
   114	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   115	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   116	relative-open gate below. -/
   117	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   118	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   119	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   120	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   121	
   122	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   123	
   124	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   125	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   126	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   127	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   128	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   129	
   130	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   131	
   132	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   133	
   134	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   135	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   136	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   137	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   138	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   139	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   140	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   141	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   142	  W : X.Opens
   143	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   144	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   145	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   146	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   147	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   148	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   149	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   150	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   151	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   152	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   153	
   154	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   155	
   156	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   157	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   158	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   159	
   160	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   161	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   162	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   163	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   164	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   165	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   166	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   167	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   168	      φ.app S) D.sq
   169	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   170	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   171	  · intro v w hvw
   172	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   173	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   174	
   175	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   176	
   177	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   178	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   179	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   180	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   181	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   182	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   183	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   184	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   185	  intro X g
   186	  let d := D X g
   187	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   188	
   189	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   190	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   191	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   192	  h
   193	
   194	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   195	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   196	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   197	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   198	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   199	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   200	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   201	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   202	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   203	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   204	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   205	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   206	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   207	
   208	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   209	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   210	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   211	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   212	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   213	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   214	
   215	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   216	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   217	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   218	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   219	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   220	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   221	
   222	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   223	
   224	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   225	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   226	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   227	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   228	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   229	
   230	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
   231	representer. -/
   232	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
   233	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
   234	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
   235	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   236	
   237	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   238	def rankOneAbelAff :
   239	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
   240	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   241	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
   242	
   243	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   244	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
   245	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   246	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
   247	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
   248	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
   249	
   250	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
   251	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
   252	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
   253	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
   254	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
   255	
   256	/-- Immediate consumer theorem: the restricted represented Abel map lands in the public locus.
   257	The stronger canonical inverse still needs the family-level divisor/evaluation producer; this
   258	theorem records the exact target API that consumer lanes can use today. -/
   259	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_mem {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   260	    (x : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).obj T) :
   261	    ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x :
   262	      (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
   263	  ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app T x).property
   264	
   265	end
   266	
   267	end AlgebraicGeometry
