     5	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRankOneOpen
     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativePresentation
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Assembly from a rank-one divisor-fibre pullback
    10	
    11	This file isolates the last presheaf step in the arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre construction.
    12	Its input ties an open `W` to the displayed family, supplies native presentations on every
    13	affine pullback, and supplies the canonical evaluation-divisor classifier.  The geometric input
    14	to the assembly theorem is the genuine pullback square of that evaluation divisor along Abel.
    15	The universal property of this stronger square produces, rather than assumes, the factorisation
    16	field of `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    17	
    18	The global construction of the canonical classifier and its represented pullbacks remains an
    19	upstream obligation.  The endpoint here keeps that obligation in its geometric `IsPullback`
    20	form and feeds the resulting arbitrary-scheme fibres immediately to
    21	`picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented`.
    22	
    23	Thus this module is a conditional assembly interface, not the missing global producer: no
    24	declaration below constructs the evaluator, the open family, or its pullback theorem.
    25	-/
    26	
    27	set_option autoImplicit false
    28	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    29	
    30	universe u
    31	
    32	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    33	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    34	
    35	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    36	
    37	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    38	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    39	
    40	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    41	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    42	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    43	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	abbrev rankOneAmbient : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    48	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    49	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))
    50	
    51	abbrev rankOneLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    52	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
    53	
    54	/-- The divisor families whose Abel class has a rank-one presentation, extended to the big site. -/
    55	abbrev rankOneDivisorLocus : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u :=
    56	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k))
    57	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor
    58	
    59	/-- The restricted represented Abel map on the big site. -/
    60	def rankOneAbelSigma :
    61	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    62	      rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
    63	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (rankOneAbelRepresented pi)
    64	
    65	/-- The ambient class of a divisor already known to lie in the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    66	def rankOneDivisorToAmbient :
    67	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C) :=
    68	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi
    69	
    70	/-! ## The explicit geometric input -/
    71	
    72	/-- The single canonical evaluation-divisor classifier used by every represented fibre.
    73	
    74	Keeping this datum outside `PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput` prevents the classifier from
    75	varying with the test scheme or displayed family. -/
    76	structure PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData where
    77	  divisor : rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ⟶
    78	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)
    79	  divisor_abel : divisor ≫ rankOneAbelSigma pi = 𝟙 _
    80	
    81	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
    82	
    83	/-- Applying restricted Abel to the canonical evaluation divisor recovers its rank-one class. -/
    84	lemma divisor_abel_app (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
    85	    (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) :
    86	    (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) = v := by
    87	  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_abel
    88	
    89	/-- The canonical divisor has the original ambient Picard class. -/
    90	lemma divisor_toAmbient (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    91	    E.divisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi = picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi := by
    92	  rw [rankOneDivisorToAmbient, ← Category.assoc, E.divisor_abel, Category.id_comp]
    93	
    94	/-- The separate uniqueness obligation saying every divisor in the rank-one presentation
    95	preimage is the canonical evaluation divisor of its Abel class. -/
    96	def AbelInverse (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) : Prop :=
    97	  rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor = 𝟙 _
    98	
    99	/-- Once divisor uniqueness is proved, restricted Abel and canonical evaluation form the
   100	rank-one family isomorphism. -/
   101	def evaluationIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) (h : E.AbelInverse) :
   102	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) where
   103	  hom := rankOneAbelSigma pi
   104	  inv := E.divisor
   105	  hom_inv_id := h
   106	  inv_hom_id := E.divisor_abel
   107	
   108	end PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   109	
   110	/--
   111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
   112	
   113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
   114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
   115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
   116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
   117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
   118	
   119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
   120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
   121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
   122	-/
   123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
   127	  W : X.Opens
   128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   129	  restrictedValue_eq :
   130	    restrictedValue =
   131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
   132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
   133	  nativePresentation :
   134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
   136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))
   138	
   139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   140	
   141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
   143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
   144	
   145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   147	    (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   151	
   152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   156	
   157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
   162	
   163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   165	def FibreFactorizationClause
   166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   169	      g.app (op S) w →
   170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   172	
   173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   176	  rw [yonedaEquiv_comp, fst, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, yonedaEquiv_apply,
   177	    ← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   180	  rfl
   181	
   182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
   188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl
   189	
   190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
   191	
   192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
   193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
   194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
   195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
   196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   198	  IsPullback
   199	    F.evaluationDivisor
   200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   202	    g
   203	
   204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   205	test scheme. -/
   206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   210	  intro S v w hvw
   211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   213	  have hcompat :
   214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   216	        g.app (op S) w := by
   217	    have h := congrArg
   218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   219	    change
   220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   223	    rw [h]
   224	    exact hvw
   225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
   229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   231	  calc
   232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
   233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
   234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
   235	      (E.divisor_abel_app pi S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
   236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
   237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
   238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app pi S v
   239	
   240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   241	
   242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   248	  W := F.W
   249	  fst := F.fst
   250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   251	  exists_factor := by
   252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).W = F.W :=
   260	  rfl
   261	
   262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).isPullback
   267	
   268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   269	
   270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   280	  intro X g

   164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/

   166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =

   170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   172

   174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   176	  rw [yonedaEquiv_comp, fst, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, yonedaEquiv_apply,
   177	    ← F.restrictedValue_eq]

   179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]

   183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]

   191	
   192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
   193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
   194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
   195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
   196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   198	  IsPullback
   199	    F.evaluationDivisor
   200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   202	    g
   203	
   204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   205	test scheme. -/
   206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   210	  intro S v w hvw
   211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)

   214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   216	        g.app (op S) w := by
   217	    have h := congrArg
   218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   219	    change
   220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   223	    rw [h]

   226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat

   228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
   229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   231	  calc
   232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
   233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
   234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
   235	      (E.divisor_abel_app pi S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
   236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
   237	      congrArg _ huDivisor

   241	
   242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   248	  W := F.W
   249	  fst := F.fst
   250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   251	  exists_factor := by
   252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).W = F.W :=
   260	  rfl

   262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).isPullback
   267	
   268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   269	
   270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)

   273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   280	  intro X g
   281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi (hpb X g)
   282

"}, {"type": "input_text", "text": "===== jacdata-import-end =====
   227	/-! ## The hypothesis bundle of the frozen `Jacobian` suffices
   228	
   229	`Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean` introduces `[GeometricallyReduced C.hom]` before its sheaf and
   230	representability statements, while the frozen `Jacobian` of `Challenge.lean` carries only
   231	`IsProper`, `SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1` and `GeometricallyIrreducible`.  There is no gap:
   232	geometric reducedness is *derived* from smoothness of relative dimension one by the global
   233	instances of `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.GeometricallyReduced`, which is in the import closure of
   234	`Pic0SigmaSheaf.lean`.  Hence every declaration above elaborates under the frozen bundle alone,
   235	and the example below records it. -/
   236	
   237	example : GeometricallyReduced C.hom := inferInstance
   238	
   239	/-! ## What remains
   240	
   241	`JacobianData.ofCharts` reduces the frozen `Jacobian` of `Challenge.lean` — that is, the
   242	production of `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, from which `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J` —
   243	to a single geometric statement about the degree-zero Picard sheaf of the curve, namely the
   244	existence of a finite Zariski atlas:
   245	
   246	> there exist a finite index type `ι`, schemes `X : ι → Scheme`, and morphisms of presheaves
   247	> `f i : yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ pic0SigmaFunctor C` such that
   248	>
   249	> 1. **(relative representability)** each `f i` is a relatively representable open immersion,
   250	>    `IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i)`;
   251	> 2. **(coverage)** the family is jointly locally surjective for the big Zariski topology,
   252	>    `Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)`;
   253	> 3. **(chart finiteness)** each chart is locally of finite type over the base field with
   254	>    respect to its own structure morphism, `LocallyOfFiniteType (chartHom C f i)`, and each
   255	>    chart space is quasi-compact, `CompactSpace (X i)`.
   256	
   257	Nothing else about the Picard functor is needed: the sheaf condition is already discharged
   258	(`pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf`), the gluing is mathlib's (`Scheme.LocalRepresentability`), the
   259	Σ-descent to the slice is already discharged (`Functor.RepresentableBy.overSlice`), and the two
   260	certificates of the glued object are discharged here from (3).
   261	
   262	Conditions (1) and (2) are the geometric input — they are what the divisor-scheme/Abel-map
   263	machinery of the `DivScheme…` and `DivRep…` files exists to produce, one chart being carved out
   264	of a symmetric power of the curve by an effectivity locus.  Condition (3) is a property of those
   265	charts alone and does not interact with the Picard functor at all.
"}, {"type": "input_text", "text": "===== challenge-tail =====
   228	namespace Jacobian
   229	
   230	/-- The Jacobian respects isomorphisms of curves — *derived* from the bundled functor
   231	`Jacobian.functor` via `Functor.mapIso`, not a primitive. Used to compare the two sides of the
   232	cocycle, whose curves agree only up to `baseChange.compIso`. -/
   233	noncomputable def congr {k : Type u} [Field k] {C C' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   234	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   235	    [IsProper C'.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C'.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C'.hom]
   236	    (e : C ≅ C') :
   237	    (.mk (Jacobian C) : Grp (Over (Spec (.of k)))) ≅ .mk (Jacobian C') :=
   238	  let j : (⟨C⟩ : Curve k) ≅ ⟨C'⟩ :=
   239	    { hom := e.hom, inv := e.inv, hom_inv_id := e.hom_inv_id, inv_hom_id := e.inv_hom_id }
   240	  (Jacobian.functor k).mapIso j.symm.op
   241	
   242	/-- **The base-change condition.** Jacobians commute with base change of fields: a canonical
   243	isomorphism `Jac(C)_L ≅ Jac(C_L)`, as group schemes over `L`. -/
   244	noncomputable def baseChangeIso (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   245	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   246	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   247	    (baseChange k L).mapGrp.obj (.mk (Jacobian C)) ≅ .mk (Jacobian ((baseChange k L).obj C)) :=
   248	  sorry
   249	
   250	/-! ## Functoriality: the base change isomorphisms form a coherent system. -/
   251	
   252	/-- Identity coherence. -/
   253	theorem baseChangeIso_id (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   254	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   255	    baseChangeIso k k C =
   256	      (Functor.mapGrpNatIso (baseChange.idIso k)).app _
   257	        ≪≫ (Functor.mapGrpIdIso (C := Over (Spec (.of k)))).app _
   258	        ≪≫ Jacobian.congr ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).symm :=
   259	  sorry
   260	
   261	/-- Cocycle coherence for a tower `k → L → M`. -/
   262	theorem baseChangeIso_comp (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
   263	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]
   264	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   265	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   266	    baseChangeIso k M C
   267	        ≪≫ Jacobian.congr ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C) =
   268	      (Functor.mapGrpNatIso (baseChange.compIso k L M)).app _
   269	        ≪≫ (Functor.mapGrpCompIso (F := baseChange k L) (G := baseChange L M)).app _
   270	        ≪≫ (baseChange L M).mapGrp.mapIso (baseChangeIso k L C)
   271	        ≪≫ baseChangeIso L M ((baseChange k L).obj C) :=
   272	  sorry
   273	
   274	/-! ## Compatibility with the Abel-Jacobi map -/
   275	
   276	variable {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   277	
   278	theorem baseChange_ofCurve (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   279	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   280	    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :
   281	    (baseChange k L).map (ofCurve P) ≫ (baseChangeIso k L C).hom.hom.hom =
   282	      ofCurve (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (baseChange k L) ≫ (baseChange k L).map P) :=
   283	  sorry
   284	
   285	end Jacobian
   286	
   287	end AlgebraicGeometry
"}, {"type": "input_text", "text": "===== sibling-jac-tail =====
   889	/-- Existence of an Albanese witness for every smooth proper geometrically irreducible
   890	curve, uniformly in the genus via the Picard identity component `Pic⁰_{C/k}`
   891	(`picardJacobianWitness`). This packages the five protected obligations (`Jacobian`,
   892	`instGrpObj`, `smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus`, `instIsProper`,
   893	`instGeometricallyIrreducible`) into a single existence statement, and records that the
   894	Albanese property of the underlying scheme `J` is uniform over every choice of
   895	`k`-rational marked point `P : 𝟙_ _ ⟶ C` (via the `isAlbaneseFor` field of
   896	`JacobianWitness`). -/
   897	theorem nonempty_jacobianWitness (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   898	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   899	    Nonempty (JacobianWitness C) :=
   900	  ⟨picardJacobianWitness C⟩
   901	
   902	/-- A choice of Albanese witness for `C`, extracted via `Classical.choice`.
   903	Used to define `Jacobian C` and to discharge each of the four protected instances
   904	on it. -/
   905	noncomputable def jacobianWitness (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   906	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   907	    JacobianWitness C :=
   908	  Classical.choice (nonempty_jacobianWitness C)
   909	
   910	-- data
   911	/-- The Jacobian of a smooth, proper curve over a field `k`.
   912	
   913	The Jacobian is the underlying scheme of an Albanese witness for `C` (see
   914	`JacobianWitness` and `nonempty_jacobianWitness`), so it is `Pic⁰_{C/k}` in its étale
   915	form for the witness `picardJacobianWitness`, whose remaining content is the five
   916	obligations enumerated in the file header: the two étale leaves of §"The open leaves of
   917	the two witnesses" together with `Scheme.fgaPicardRepresentability` and the two residues
   918	`Pic0Et.geometricallyReduced` / `Pic0Et.universallyClosed`. The genus-`0`
   919	specialisation is implicit in the witness — a smooth proper geometrically
   920	irreducible group scheme over `k` of relative dimension `0` is `Spec k` — so
   921	no separate genus-`0` construction is needed. -/
   922	noncomputable def Jacobian (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
   923	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   924	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
   925	  (jacobianWitness C).J
   926	
   927	namespace Jacobian
   928	
   929	/-! ## The Jacobian of `C` is an abelian variety. -/
   930

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducer
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneUniquenessDischarge
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RigidityAffineReduction
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffClassDegree

/-!
# The Abel inverse of the canonical evaluation divisor, unconditionally

`rankOneDivisorUniqueness` (`Pic0RankOneUniquenessDischarge.lean`) settles, over every affine
test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, that at most one widened locally certified
divisor class of degree `genus C` has a prescribed Abel value.  This file upgrades that affine
statement into the second inverse law of the rank-one Abel/evaluation pair on the big site: every
`E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi` automatically satisfies `E.AbelInverse`, so its
`evaluationIso` is available with no extra hypothesis.

The upgrade is genuinely local-to-global on the base, and it reuses only landed material:

* **The vehicle collapse along an affine open** (`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine`):
  restricting a widened vehicle section along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U` and collapsing through the
  affine comparison recovers the section's value at the affine open `U`.  This is the `mapVal`
  no-gluing computation followed by the `Spec`-`Γ` bookkeeping identity
  `fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom`.
* **Arbitrary-test uniqueness** (`divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne`): two widened vehicle sections over
  an arbitrary test whose Abel values agree, one of whose Abel classes lies in the rank-one locus,
  are equal.  Two sections of the widened vehicle agree iff they agree on affine opens
  (`divFamZarAff.ext`); on each affine open the pulled-back rank-one class (via
  `picRankOneOpen_map_mem` along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U`) feeds the affine
  `rankOneDivisorUniqueness`, with the affine Abel value identified through
  `picEtMap_abelDivAff'`, `picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'`, and the vehicle collapse above.
* **Monomorphy of the restricted Abel map** (`rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective`): arbitrary-test
  uniqueness gives injectivity of the represented Abel map on every slice object, and the
  `Σ`-extension preserves it componentwise.

Given a right inverse (`E.divisor_abel`) and injectivity of `rankOneAbelSigma pi`, the standard
cancellation yields the left inverse `E.AbelInverse`, hence the packaged `rankOneAbelIso`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable section

/-! ## The vehicle collapse along an affine open -/

omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
/-- Restricting a widened vehicle section along the affine-open test object `Over.fromSpecAffine
T U` and collapsing through the affine comparison recovers the section's value at `U`.  The
`mapVal` no-gluing computation and the `Spec`-`Γ` bookkeeping identity
`fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom`. -/
theorem divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine (n : ℕ) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n Γ(T.left, U.1)
        (divFamZarAff.map C n (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s)
      = s.1 U := by
  rw [divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAff.map_val,
    divFamZarAff.mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C n (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s
      (top_le_preimage_fromSpecAffine T U),
    ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom T U,
    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id]

/-! ## Arbitrary-test uniqueness of the widened Abel map on the rank-one locus -/

/-- **Arbitrary-test rank-one uniqueness**: two widened vehicle sections over an arbitrary test
`T` whose widened Abel values agree, one of whose Abel classes lies in the rank-one locus, are
equal.  The vehicle is separated by affine opens, and on each affine open the pulled-back rank-one
class feeds the affine `rankOneDivisorUniqueness`. -/
theorem divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C (genus C) T)
    (hs₁ : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁ ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op T))
    (habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₁ = abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₂) :
    s₁ = s₂ := by
  refine divFamZarAff.ext fun U => ?_
  -- pull the rank-one class back along the affine-open test object
  have hmem : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
        ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)
      ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))) :=
    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hs₁
  -- the pulled-back Abel value is the affine Abel value of `s₁.1 U`
  have hval : abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1) (s₁.1 U)
      = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
            ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)).1 := by
    have h1 : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
          ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)).1
        = picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) (abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₁) := rfl
    rw [h1, picEtMap_abelDivAff', picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff',
      divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine]
  -- the two affine Abel values agree, from equality of the vehicle Abel values
  have hU := congrArg (fun w : picEt C T => w.1 U) habel
  rw [abelDivAff'_val, abelDivAff'_val] at hU
  exact rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi Γ(T.left, U.1) _ hmem (s₁.1 U) (s₂.1 U) hval
    (hU.symm.trans hval)

/-! ## Monomorphy of the restricted Abel map -/

/-- The represented Abel map is injective on every slice object: this is arbitrary-test
uniqueness read through the subfunctor preimage plumbing. -/
theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_app_injective (Z : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
    Function.Injective ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op Z)) := by
  intro x y h
  have hinj : Function.Injective
      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z)) :=
    Function.LeftInverse.injective fun a =>
      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom_inv_id_app_apply (op Z) a
  set sx := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) x.val with hsx
  set sy := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) y.val with hsy
  -- the underlying widened Abel values agree
  have happ : ∀ w : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor.obj (op Z),
      ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op Z) w).val
        = (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z)
            ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) w.val) := fun _ => rfl
  have hval : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sx
      = (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sy := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rwa [happ, happ] at this
  have habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) Z sx = abelDivAff' C (genus C) Z sy := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hval
    rwa [abelDivAffTrans_app_coe, abelDivAffTrans_app_coe] at this
  -- membership of the rank-one class of `sx`
  have hmem : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sx
      ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op Z) := x.property
  -- arbitrary-test uniqueness forces the vehicle sections to agree
  have hsxy : sx = sy := divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne pi Z sx sy hmem habel
  exact Subtype.ext (hinj (hsx ▸ hsy ▸ hsxy))

/-- Componentwise injectivity of the restricted represented Abel map on the big site: the
`Σ`-extension preserves the slicewise injectivity of `rankOneAbelRepresented`. -/
theorem rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective (Y : Schemeᵒᵖ) :
    Function.Injective ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y) := by
  rintro ⟨a, ξ⟩ ⟨b, η⟩ h
  have ha : (⟨a, (rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op (Over.mk a)) ξ⟩ :
        Σ c : Y.unop ⟶ Spec (.of k),
          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor.obj (op (Over.mk c)))
      = ⟨b, (rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op (Over.mk b)) η⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp ha
  simp only [heq_eq_eq] at h2
  obtain rfl := rankOneAbelRepresented_app_injective pi (Over.mk a) h2
  rfl

/-! ## The Abel inverse and the packaged iso -/

namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData

/-- **The Abel inverse law holds automatically**: every canonical evaluation-divisor classifier
of the rank-one locus is a two-sided inverse of the restricted Abel map.  From the right inverse
`E.divisor_abel` and injectivity of `rankOneAbelSigma pi`, the left inverse follows by
cancellation. -/
theorem abelInverse_of_uniqueness (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
    E.AbelInverse := by
  have h : rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor
      = 𝟙 (rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)) := by

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneNativeBaseChangeCartesian

/-!
# Canonicalize an existing rank-one presentation

`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` is the public producer contract, but its `module` field is an
auxiliary presentation of the cocycle sheaf.  The native rank-one consumer needs the canonical
`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.nativeModule` instead.  This file supplies the honest bridge: it keeps the
same cover, representative, and cocycle datum, copies the cohomology/rank certificates, and
derives native pushforward base change from the actual datum's vanishing theorem.  No new witness
or unrelated module is introduced.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

namespace PicRankOneNativePresentation

variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
variable {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}

/-- Replace the auxiliary module in a local presentation by the datum's canonical native module.

The native pushforward comparison is obtained from the same datum and its `H¹` certificate, so
the resulting structure remains tied to the original lambda value and does not assume a new
base-change theorem.
-/
noncomputable def ofLocalPresentation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
  { cover := P.cover
    representative := P.representative
    represents := P.represents
    datum := P.datum
    datum_class := P.datum_class
    native_pushforward_base_change := fun g f' g' sq =>
      P.datum.isIso_canonicalBaseChangeMap_nativeModule
        ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
        g f' g' sq
    h1_vanishing := P.h1_vanishing
    h0_finite := P.h0_finite
    h0_projective := P.h0_projective
    h0_rank_one := P.h0_rank_one }

/-- A local presentation always yields a nonempty canonical native presentation. -/
theorem nonempty_of_localPresentation
    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) :=
  ⟨ofLocalPresentation pi P⟩

/-- Convert the complete affine-pullback producer contract to its native form.

The conversion is pointwise but preserves the exact pulled-back lambda and the actual datum at
each test algebra; it is therefore suitable for a later native `FibrePresented` consumer.
-/
theorem nonempty_of_localPresentations
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
  intro A _ _ t
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := h A t
  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_localPresentation pi P

end PicRankOneNativePresentation

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# Native presentations for split field classes

A residue-field H¹ witness for the lambda-tied cocycle datum supplies its arbitrary-ring
cohomology and rank certificates.  The native all-cartesian base-change theorem then completes
the corresponding `PicRankOneNativePresentation` without a separate pushforward hypothesis.

A split genus-degree class over a field stays split after every affine coefficient extension,
so it supplies those witnesses for each pullback datum.

The final theorem is the direct public consumer: a split field class belongs to
`PicRankOneOpen`, because every affine pullback receives the presentation constructed here.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

noncomputable section

/-- Every morphism between affine tests over `Spec k` is induced by a `k`-algebra map.

Unlike `exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom`, neither coefficient ring is required to be a
field.  This is the form needed when the target of a field-valued Picard point is tested by an
arbitrary affine scheme. -/
theorem exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing
    (R S : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
    (t : overSpec k S ⟶ overSpec k R) :
    ∃ e : R →ₐ[k] S, t = Over.overSpecMap e := by
  have hw : t.left ≫ (overSpec k R).hom = (overSpec k S).hom := Over.w t
  let psi : CommRingCat.of R ⟶ CommRingCat.of S := Spec.preimage t.left
  have hmap : Spec.map psi = t.left := Spec.map_preimage t.left
  have htower : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k R) ≫ psi =
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k S) := by
    apply Spec.map_injective
    rw [Spec.map_comp, hmap]
    exact hw
  let e : R →ₐ[k] S :=
    { __ := psi.hom
      commutes' := fun r ↦
        congrArg (fun f => f r) (congrArg CommRingCat.Hom.hom htower) }
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  ext : 1
  exact hmap.symm

/-- Complete the native presentation attached to an actual lambda-tied datum.

The input is exactly the remaining family-level H¹ obligation.  The degree law follows from the
two class equalities stored in `P`; finiteness, projectivity, and rank one follow from the
arbitrary-ring certificate theorem; and native pushforward base change is the canonical
all-cartesian theorem.  Thus every field concerns the same cocycle datum. -/
noncomputable def PicRankOneNativeDatum.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    (P : PicRankOneNativeDatum pi lam)
    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    (hres : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier,
      P.datum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam :=
  PicRankOneNativePresentation.ofCertificatesWithNativeBaseChange
    P.cover P.representative P.represents P.datum P.datum_class
      (RankOneFamilyCertificates.ofActualDatum P.datum hpi hres
        (fun L ↦ P.classDeg_baseChange L))

/-- The arbitrary-affine pullback of a split field class has a complete native presentation.

The datum is the representative extracted from the displayed pullback `lam`.  Its residue-field
H¹ witnesses come from `hsplit`, while its degree law comes from the equality with `lam`.
Consequently all four cohomology/rank fields and the native base-change field concern the same
cocycle datum. -/
theorem PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
    {K A : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    (e : K →ₐ[k] A) (nu : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    (hlam : lam.1 = picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap e) nu)
    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C nu) :
    Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi lam) := by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := PicRankOneNativeDatum.nonempty (C := C) pi lam
  exact ⟨P.toNativePresentation_of_residueH1Witness hpi
    (P.residueH1Witness_of_fieldPullback e nu hlam hsplit)⟩

/-- A split genus-degree class over a field belongs to the public rank-one Picard locus.

Every affine test morphism into `Spec K` is induced by a `k`-algebra map `K → A`; the
preceding producer therefore supplies the exact native presentation required on that pullback.
-/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_isSplitWitness
    (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom)
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k K))
    (hsplit : IsSplitWitness C lam.1) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k K)) := by
  apply mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
  intro A _ _ t
  obtain ⟨e, ht⟩ := exists_algHom_eq_of_overSpec_hom_of_commRing (k := k) K A t
  rw [ht]
  exact PicRankOneNativePresentation.nonempty_of_fieldPullback
    (C := C) hpi e lam.1 rfl hsplit

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

/-!
# Arbitrary-cartesian base change for the native rank-one module

The vanishing of the first Cech cohomology of a basic-open cocycle datum makes
global sections commute with every scalar extension.  On each affine chart of
an arbitrary test scheme, the cartesian family is the corresponding scalar
extension of the relative curve.  The two affine section presentations then
identify the canonical Beck--Chevalley mate with that scalar-extension
equivalence.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace MonoidalCategory
  CartesianMonoidalCategory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Over.sectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]

namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum

noncomputable section

local instance nativeSectionsModuleCartesian
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
    (W : (relCurve C B).Opens) : Module B Γ(D.nativeModule, W) :=
  Scheme.moduleKSections
    (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) D.nativeModule W

private noncomputable def pullbackCongrCompSectionsEquiv
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (eq : h = f ≫ g) (N : Z.Modules) :
    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj N, ⊤) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N, ⊤) := by
  let sheafIso := (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eq).app N ≪≫
    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).symm.app N
  let topAdd : Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback h).obj N, ⊤) ≃+
      Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj N, ⊤) :=
    { toFun := fun x ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app sheafIso.hom ⊤).hom x
      invFun := fun x ↦ (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app sheafIso.inv ⊤).hom x
      left_inv := fun x ↦ by
        simp only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
          sheafIso.hom_inv_id, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      right_inv := fun x ↦ by
        simp only [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
          sheafIso.inv_hom_id, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app,
          AddCommGrpCat.hom_id, AddMonoidHom.id_apply]
      map_add' := fun x y ↦
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app sheafIso.hom ⊤).hom.map_add x y }
  exact topAdd.toLinearEquiv (fun r x ↦
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul sheafIso.hom r x)

private lemma pullbackCongrCompSectionsEquiv_baseMap
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (h : X ⟶ Z)
    (eq : h = f ≫ g) (N : Z.Modules)
    {V : Y.Opens} {W : Z.Opens}
    (eV : V ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ W) (eT : (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (eTW : (⊤ : X.Opens) ≤ h ⁻¹ᵁ W) (x : Γ(N, W)) :
    pullbackCongrCompSectionsEquiv f g h eq N
        (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap h N eTW x) =
      pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap f
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj N) eT
          (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap g N eV x) := by
  apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) ⊤)).injective
  change (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).hom.app N) ⊤).hom
        ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f g).inv.app N) ⊤).hom
          ((Scheme.Modules.Hom.app
            ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr eq).hom.app N) ⊤).hom
            (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap h N eTW x))) = _
  rw [← AddCommGrpCat.comp_apply, ← Scheme.Modules.Hom.comp_app,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Scheme.Modules.Hom.id_app,
    id_apply]
  rw [pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_congr eq N eTW
    (eT.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f eV)) x]
  exact (pullback_app_isoTensor_baseMap_comp f g N eV eT
    (eT.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f eV)) x).symm

private lemma affineChart_overSpecMap
    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (U : T.left.affineOpens)
    (gOver : T ⟶ overSpec k B) :
    let R := Γ(T.left, U.1)
    let phi : B →ₐ[k] R :=
      (Over.appLEAlgHom gOver ⊤ U.1 le_top).comp
        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom
    letI : Algebra B R := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower k B R :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (phi.commutes x).symm
    overSpecMap (k := k) B R = Over.fromSpecAffine T U ≫ gOver := by
  dsimp only
  let phi : B →ₐ[k] Γ(T.left, U.1) :=
    (Over.appLEAlgHom gOver ⊤ U.1 le_top).comp
      (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom
  letI : Algebra B Γ(T.left, U.1) := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k B Γ(T.left, U.1) :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (phi.commutes x).symm
  have htop : Over.overSpecMap (k := k)
        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom =
      Over.fromSpecAffine (overSpec k B) (overSpecTopAffine B) := by
    ext : 1
    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom.toRingHom) =
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of B))).fromSpec
    rw [IsAffineOpen.fromSpec_top, Scheme.isoSpec_Spec_inv]
    congr 1
  have hnat := Over.fromSpecAffine_naturality gOver
    (overSpecTopAffine B) U le_top
  have hmap : overSpecMap (k := k) B Γ(T.left, U.1) =
      Over.overSpecMap phi := by
    ext : 1
    rfl
  rw [hmap, show phi =
      (Over.appLEAlgHom gOver ⊤ U.1 le_top).comp
        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom from rfl,
    Over.overSpecMap_comp, htop]
  simpa only [overSpecTopAffine] using hnat

private lemma cartesianAffineChart
    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of B)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C B)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
      (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B)) g)
    (U : T'.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) :
    let R := Γ(T', U)
    letI : Algebra k R :=
      Over.sectionsAlgebra
        (X := Over.mk (g ≫ (overSpec k B).hom)) U
    let phi : B →ₐ[k] R :=
      (Over.appLEAlgHom
          (Over.homMk g rfl :
            Over.mk (g ≫ (overSpec k B).hom) ⟶ overSpec k B)
          ⊤ U le_top).comp
        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom
    letI : Algebra B R := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : IsScalarTower k B R :=
      IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (phi.commutes x).symm
    ∃ a : relCurve C R ⟶ X', ∃ ha : IsOpenImmersion a,
      @Scheme.Hom.opensRange _ _ a ha = f' ⁻¹ᵁ U ∧
      a ≫ g' = relCurveMap C B R ∧
      a ≫ f' = (snd C (overSpec k R)).left ≫ hU.fromSpec := by
  dsimp only
  let T : Over (Spec (.of k)) := Over.mk (g ≫ (overSpec k B).hom)
  let gOver : T ⟶ overSpec k B := Over.homMk g rfl
  let Ua : T.left.affineOpens := ⟨U, hU⟩
  let R := Γ(T.left, Ua.1)
  let phi : B →ₐ[k] R :=
    (Over.appLEAlgHom gOver ⊤ Ua.1 le_top).comp
      (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k B).symm.toAlgHom
  letI : Algebra B R := phi.toRingHom.toAlgebra
  letI : IsScalarTower k B R :=
    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun x ↦ (phi.commutes x).symm
  have hOverMap : overSpecMap (k := k) B R =
      Over.fromSpecAffine T Ua ≫ gOver :=
    affineChart_overSpecMap T Ua gOver
  let hcan := Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft_snd C gOver
  let eX : X' ≅ (C ⊗ T).left :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback (relCurve C B) T.left sq hcan
  have heXfst : eX.hom ≫ (C ◁ gOver).left = g' :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_fst _ _ sq hcan
  have heXsnd : eX.hom ≫ (snd C T).left = f' :=
    IsPullback.isoIsPullback_hom_snd _ _ sq hcan
  let W : (C ⊗ T).left.Opens := (snd C T).left ⁻¹ᵁ U
  have hpre : eX.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W = f' ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    calc
      eX.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W = (eX.hom ≫ (snd C T).left) ⁻¹ᵁ U :=
        (Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage eX.hom (snd C T).left U).symm
      _ = f' ⁻¹ᵁ U := congrArg (fun q : X' ⟶ T' ↦ q ⁻¹ᵁ U) heXsnd
  let eU : relCurve C R ≅ (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme :=
    relCurveAffineOpenIso C T Ua ≪≫
      pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict (snd C T).left U ≪≫
      (eX.hom.preimageIso W).symm ≪≫
      X'.isoOfEq hpre
  let a : relCurve C R ⟶ X' := eU.hom ≫ (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion a := by
    dsimp [a]
    infer_instance
  have haRange : a.opensRange = f' ⁻¹ᵁ U := by
    dsimp [a]
    rw [Scheme.Hom.opensRange_comp_of_isIso, Scheme.Opens.opensRange_ι]
  have hCover :
      (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict (snd C T).left U).hom ≫ W.ι =
        (relCurveAffineCover C T).f Ua := by
    exact pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict_hom_ι (snd C T).left U
  have hPreimage :
      (eX.hom.preimageIso W).symm.hom ≫
          (eX.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ eX.hom = W.ι := by
    change (eX.hom.preimageIso W).inv ≫
      (eX.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ eX.hom = W.ι
    exact Scheme.Hom.preimageIso_inv_ι eX.hom W
  have ha_eX : a ≫ eX.hom =
      (C ◁ Over.fromSpecAffine T Ua).left := by
    calc
      a ≫ eX.hom =
          (relCurveAffineOpenIso C T Ua).hom ≫
            (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict (snd C T).left U).hom ≫
              (eX.hom.preimageIso W).symm.hom ≫
                (X'.isoOfEq hpre).hom ≫ (f' ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι ≫ eX.hom := by
        simp only [a, eU, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
      _ = (relCurveAffineOpenIso C T Ua).hom ≫
            (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict (snd C T).left U).hom ≫
              (eX.hom.preimageIso W).symm.hom ≫
                (eX.hom ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ eX.hom := by
        rw [Scheme.isoOfEq_hom_ι_assoc]
      _ = (relCurveAffineOpenIso C T Ua).hom ≫
            (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict (snd C T).left U).hom ≫ W.ι := by
        simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg
          (fun q ↦ (relCurveAffineOpenIso C T Ua).hom ≫
            (pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict (snd C T).left U).hom ≫ q)
          hPreimage
      _ = (relCurveAffineOpenIso C T Ua).hom ≫
            (relCurveAffineCover C T).f Ua := by
        rw [hCover]
      _ = (C ◁ Over.fromSpecAffine T Ua).left :=
        relCurveAffineOpenIso_hom_f C T Ua
  have ha_f' : a ≫ f' =
      (snd C (overSpec k R)).left ≫ hU.fromSpec := by
    calc
      a ≫ f' = a ≫ (eX.hom ≫ (snd C T).left) := by rw [heXsnd]
      _ = (a ≫ eX.hom) ≫ (snd C T).left := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (C ◁ Over.fromSpecAffine T Ua).left ≫ (snd C T).left := by rw [ha_eX]
      _ = (snd C (overSpec k R)).left ≫ hU.fromSpec := by
        exact congrArg Over.Hom.left
          (whiskerLeft_snd C (Over.fromSpecAffine T Ua))
  have ha_g' : a ≫ g' = relCurveMap C B R := by
    calc
      a ≫ g' = a ≫ (eX.hom ≫ (C ◁ gOver).left) := by rw [heXfst]
      _ = (a ≫ eX.hom) ≫ (C ◁ gOver).left := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (C ◁ Over.fromSpecAffine T Ua).left ≫ (C ◁ gOver).left := by
        rw [ha_eX]
      _ = relCurveMap C B R := by
        rw [← Over.comp_left, ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp, ← hOverMap]
        rfl
  exact ⟨a, inferInstance, haRange, ha_g', ha_f'⟩

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DegreeZero

     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The degree at field points and the degree-zero Picard functor (G-D6/G-D7, SB-7)
    11	
    12	For the challenge curve `C` over `k`, an étale Picard class `λ : picEt C T` on an
    13	arbitrary test object restricts along any field point `t : overSpec k K ⟶ T` to a class
    14	of the affine étale Picard group of `Spec K`, which collapses through the affine
    15	comparison `picEtAffineEquiv` to a plus class in `PicEtAff C K` — whose degree
    16	`PicEtAff.degAff` (SB-6) is an honest integer.
    17	
    18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.degAt λ t` — **the degree of an étale Picard class at a field
    19	  point** (gap G-D6): the plus-class degree of the restriction of `λ` along `t`.
    20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.degAt_picEtMap` / `degAt_picEtFunctor_map` — functoriality: the
    21	  degree of a restricted class at a field point is the degree of the original class at
    22	  the composed field point.  Pure `picEtMap_comp` rewriting, which is what makes the
    23	  degree-zero subfunctor stability definitional.
    24	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Subgroup C T` — the subgroup of classes of degree zero at
    25	  *every* field point of `T` (membership: `mem_pic0Subgroup_iff`).
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.pic0Functor C : (Over (Spec k))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat` — **the
    27	  degree-zero relative Picard functor `Pic⁰_{C/k}`** (gap G-D7): the subgroup
    28	  subfunctor of `picEtFunctor C` cut out by the degree-zero condition, the binding
    29	  carrier of the Wave-4 representability statement (`RepresentableBy`, design §2.7).
    30	  The restriction maps are `pic0Map`, with underlying-class equation `pic0Map_coe`
    31	  (the naturality square of the inclusion, element form) and the bundled inclusion
    32	  natural transformation `pic0Inclusion : pic0Functor C ⟶ picEtFunctor C`.
    33	-/
    34	
    35	set_option autoImplicit false
    36	
    37	universe u
    38	
    39	open CategoryTheory
    40	
    41	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    42	
    43	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    44	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    45	
    46	noncomputable section
    47	
    48	/-! ## The degree at a field point -/
    49	
    50	/-- **The degree of an étale Picard class at a field point** (gap G-D6): restrict along
    51	`t : overSpec k K ⟶ T`, collapse by the affine comparison to a plus class of the test
    52	algebra `K`, and take its degree (SB-6).  Well-defined in the representative of the
    53	restricted class by the zigzag (WD) underlying `PicEtAff.degAff`. -/
    54	def degAt {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) {K : Type u} [Field K]
    55	    [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) : ℤ :=
    56	  PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t lam))
    57	
    58	section DegAt
    59	
    60	variable {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    61	
    62	/-- The trivial class has degree zero at every field point. -/
    63	@[simp]
    64	theorem degAt_one (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) : degAt (1 : picEt C T) t = 0 := by
    65	  change PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t 1)) = 0
    66	  rw [map_one, map_one, PicEtAff.degAff_one]
    67	
    68	/-- The degree at a field point of a product of classes is the sum of the degrees. -/
    69	theorem degAt_mul (lam mu : picEt C T) (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
    70	    degAt (lam * mu) t = degAt lam t + degAt mu t := by
    71	  change PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t (lam * mu)))
    72	      = PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t lam))
    73	        + PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t mu))
    74	  rw [map_mul, map_mul, PicEtAff.degAff_mul]
    75	
    76	/-- The degree at a field point of an inverse class is the negation of the degree. -/
    77	theorem degAt_inv (lam : picEt C T) (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
    78	    degAt lam⁻¹ t = -degAt lam t := by
    79	  change PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t lam⁻¹)) = -degAt lam t
    80	  rw [map_inv, map_inv, PicEtAff.degAff_inv]
    81	  rfl
    82	
    83	/-- **Functoriality of the degree at field points** (restriction form): the degree of a
    84	restricted class at a field point is the degree of the original class at the composed
    85	field point.  Pure `picEtMap_comp` rewriting — this is what makes the stability of the
    86	degree-zero subfunctor definitional. -/
    87	theorem degAt_picEtMap (f : T' ⟶ T) (lam : picEt C T) (t' : overSpec k K ⟶ T') :
    88	    degAt (picEtMap C f lam) t' = degAt lam (t' ≫ f) := by
    89	  change PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C t' (picEtMap C f lam)))
    90	      = PicEtAff.degAff K (picEtAffineEquiv C K (picEtMap C (t' ≫ f) lam))
    91	  rw [← picEtMap_comp]
    92	
    93	/-- Functoriality of the degree at field points, functor form. -/
    94	theorem degAt_picEtFunctor_map (f : T' ⟶ T) (lam : picEt C T)
    95	    (t' : overSpec k K ⟶ T') :
    96	    degAt ((picEtFunctor C).map f.op lam) t' = degAt lam (t' ≫ f) :=
    97	  degAt_picEtMap f lam t'
    98	
    99	end DegAt
   100	
   101	/-! ## The degree-zero subfunctor -/
   102	
   103	variable (C) in
   104	/-- **The degree-zero subgroup** of the étale Picard group of a test object: the
   105	classes of degree zero at every field point of the test.  The object part of the
   106	degree-zero Picard functor `pic0Functor` (gap G-D7). -/
   107	def pic0Subgroup (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Subgroup (picEt C T) where
   108	  carrier := {lam | ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
   109	    degAt lam t = 0}
   110	  one_mem' := by
   111	    intro K _ _ t
   112	    exact degAt_one t
   113	  mul_mem' := by
   114	    intro a b ha hb K _ _ t
   115	    rw [degAt_mul, ha K t, hb K t, add_zero]
   116	  inv_mem' := by
   117	    intro a ha K _ _ t
   118	    rw [degAt_inv, ha K t, neg_zero]
   119	
   120	/-- Membership in the degree-zero subgroup: degree zero at every field point. -/
   121	theorem mem_pic0Subgroup_iff {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} :
   122	    lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C T
   123	      ↔ ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T),
   124	          degAt lam t = 0 :=
   125	  Iff.rfl
   126	
   127	variable (C) in
   128	/-- Restriction of degree-zero classes along a morphism of test objects: the map part
   129	of the degree-zero Picard functor.  The stability of the degree-zero condition is
   130	definitional through the functoriality `degAt_picEtMap` of the degree at field
   131	points. -/
   132	def pic0Map {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T) :
   133	    pic0Subgroup C T →* pic0Subgroup C T' :=
   134	  ((picEtMap C f).comp (pic0Subgroup C T).subtype).codRestrict (pic0Subgroup C T')
   135	    fun lam K _ _ t' => (degAt_picEtMap f (lam : picEt C T) t').trans (lam.2 K (t' ≫ f))
   136	
   137	/-- The underlying étale Picard class of a restricted degree-zero class — the
   138	naturality square of the subfunctor inclusion, element form. -/
   139	@[simp]
   140	theorem pic0Map_coe {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
   141	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T) :
   142	    (pic0Map C f lam : picEt C T') = picEtMap C f (lam : picEt C T) :=
   143	  rfl
   144	
   145	variable (C) in
   146	/-- **The degree-zero relative Picard functor `Pic⁰_{C/k}`** (gap G-D7): the subgroup
   147	subfunctor of the étale-sheafified relative Picard functor `picEtFunctor C` of classes
   148	of degree zero at every field point of the test object.  This is the binding carrier of
   149	the Wave-4 representability statement (design §2.7): the Jacobian represents *this*
   150	functor. -/
   151	def pic0Functor : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ ⥤ CommGrpCat.{u} where
   152	  obj T := CommGrpCat.of (pic0Subgroup C T.unop)
   153	  map g := CommGrpCat.ofHom (pic0Map C g.unop)
   154	  map_id T := by
   155	    ext lam U
   156	    exact congrArg (fun z : picEt C T.unop => z.1 U) (picEtMap_id C (lam : picEt C T.unop))
   157	  map_comp g h := by
   158	    ext lam U
   159	    exact congrArg (fun z => z.1 U) (picEtMap_comp C g.unop h.unop (lam : picEt C _))
   160	
   161	@[simp]
   162	theorem pic0Functor_obj (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) :
   163	    (pic0Functor C).obj T = CommGrpCat.of (pic0Subgroup C T.unop) :=
   164	  rfl
   165	
   166	@[simp]
   167	theorem pic0Functor_map {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ} (g : T ⟶ T')
   168	    (lam : pic0Subgroup C T.unop) :
   169	    (pic0Functor C).map g lam = pic0Map C g.unop lam :=
   170	  rfl
   171	
   172	variable (C) in
   173	/-- The inclusion of the degree-zero subfunctor into the étale-sheafified relative
   174	Picard functor, as a natural transformation — the naturality square consumers cite
   175	(bundled form of `pic0Map_coe`). -/
   176	def pic0Inclusion : pic0Functor C ⟶ picEtFunctor C where
   177	  app T := CommGrpCat.ofHom (pic0Subgroup C T.unop).subtype
   178	  naturality _ _ _ := rfl
   179	
   180	end
   181	
   182	end AlgebraicGeometry

     9	/-!
    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	variable (C n) in
    42	/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
    43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
    44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
    45	  naturality T T' g := by
    46	    ext s
    47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
    49	
    50	@[simp]
    51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
    54	  rfl
    55	
    56	variable (C n) in
    57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
    58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
    61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)
    63	
    64	@[simp]
    65	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
    77	  rfl
    78	
    79	variable (C) in
    80	/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.
    81	
    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
    83	be an open immersion. -/
    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    85	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
    86	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
    87	  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)
    88	
    89	end
    90	
    91	end AlgebraicGeometry

     8	/-!
     9	# The Jacobian representability datum (Wave-4 seam D1, `JacobianData`)
    10	
    11	The pinned representability datum for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative Picard
    12	functor `pic0Functor C` of the challenge curve: a representing object `J`, an honest
    13	`Functor.RepresentableBy` datum (no `Nonempty`, no choice), and the two construction
    14	certificates (`LocallyOfFiniteType`, `QuasiCompact`).  This is the frozen Wave-4
    15	interface shape (`informal/w4-datum-worksheet.md` §1.1, verbatim), together with the
    16	design-§5 consumers `grpObj` / `homEquiv` / `uniqueUpToIso` — and nothing else.
    17	
    18	## Ownership split (binding, w5-worksheet D1)
    19	
    20	* The **producer** `jacobianData C : JacobianData C`, the quasi-compactness certificate,
    21	  and the discharge of the frozen `Jacobian`/`instGrpObj` sorries of `Challenge.lean`
    22	  are **DAT-J property** (the parallel Wave-4 fleet).  None of them lives here.
    23	* This file is the **Wave-5/6/7 consumption interface**: downstream files take
    24	  `(d : JacobianData C)` as a section variable, activate the group structure per proof
    25	  via `letI := d.grpObj` (or `attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`), and
    26	  phrase every statement about `d.J`.  At DAT-J discharge time the frozen gate
    27	  instantiates them by `exact theorem_x … (jacobianData C)` — definitionally, since
    28	  `Jacobian C := (jacobianData C).J`.
    29	* Extensions to this file are **additive only**; the structure shape never changes.
    30	
    31	## The `forget₂ ⋙ forget` massage
    32	
    33	`rep` is typed against `(pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat`
    34	so that mathlib's `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies **verbatim** with
    35	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat`.  The functor value at a test `T` is
    36	*definitionally* the coerced subgroup `↥(pic0Subgroup C T)`; `homEquiv` and
    37	`homEquiv_comp` below own this defeq once, exposing the equivalence against
    38	`pic0Subgroup C T` and the naturality against `pic0Map` — no consumer ever meets the
    39	`forget₂ ⋙ forget` spelling again.
    40	
    41	## η-defeq verdict (recon §5 "lower-order unknown", RECORDED)
    42	
    43	**POSITIVE, with one keying caveat.**  `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally equal to
    44	`d.J` (structure-eta for `Comma`/`CostructuredArrow` plus unit-like eta for the
    45	`Discrete PUnit` right leg): the ascription
    46	`(d.grpObj : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom))` elaborates as-is, so **no transport lemma is
    47	ever needed**.  Caveat: bare instance *search* does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own,
    48	so a consumer of `smooth_of_grpObj` — whose group hypothesis is `[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]`
    49	at `f := d.J.hom` — must key the instance at the `Over.mk` spelling:
    50	`letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj` (pure defeq, zero cost; mathlib itself
    51	uses the same ascription idiom in `Group/Smooth.lean`).  Instances stated directly on
    52	`G : Over (Spec (.of K))` (e.g. `IsClosedImmersion η[G].left`) fire on `d.J` with no
    53	massage at all.  The `example`-level smoke tests at the bottom of this file are the
    54	machine-checked record; the T-chain (tangent lane) and S2 (`Smooth` via
    55	`smooth_of_grpObj`) may rely on this freely.
    56	
    57	## Main declarations
    58	
    59	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData C` — the frozen datum structure.
    60	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.grpObj` — the group-object structure on `d.J` via
    61	  `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` (the discharge route of the frozen `instGrpObj`).
    62	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.homEquiv` / `homEquiv_comp` — the universal property
    63	  in consumer form: `(T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T`, natural against `pic0Map`.
    64	* `AlgebraicGeometry.JacobianData.uniqueUpToIso` / `homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom` — any
    65	  two data have canonically isomorphic representing objects (Wave-7's `baseChangeIso`
    66	  mechanism), with the intertwining property.
    67	-/
    68	
    69	set_option autoImplicit false
    70	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    71	
    72	universe u
    73	
    74	open CategoryTheory Opposite
    75	
    76	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    77	
    78	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
    79	
    80	/-- **The pinned representability datum** for the degree-zero étale-sheafified relative
    81	Picard functor of the curve `C` (w4-datum-worksheet §1.1, frozen).  Produced once, by
    82	explicit construction, in Wave 4 (DAT-J: `jacobianData`); consumed as a section
    83	variable everywhere else.  NEVER a sorried instance, NEVER `Nonempty` + choice.
    84	
    85	The typing of `rep` is chosen so that `GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` applies verbatim with
    86	`F := pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat` (see `JacobianData.grpObj`). -/
    87	structure JacobianData (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    88	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
    89	    Type (u + 1) where
    90	  /-- The representing object (the Jacobian-to-be). -/
    91	  J : Over (Spec (.of k))
    92	  /-- The pinned universal datum: `Hom(T, J) ≃ Pic⁰(T)`, naturally in the test `T`. -/
    93	  rep : ((pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) ⋙ forget GrpCat).RepresentableBy J
    94	  /-- Certificate from the construction (Kleiman 4.8(1) shape); NOT re-derived via the
    95	  EGA limit criterion. -/
    96	  locallyOfFiniteType : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom
    97	  /-- Certificate from the construction (a posteriori: `|J|` is the image of a
    98	  quasi-compact divisor scheme under the Abel map).  Feeds `IsProper` (Wave 5) via
    99	  `finite type = qc + lft`. -/
   100	  quasiCompact : QuasiCompact J.hom
   101	
   102	namespace JacobianData
   103	
   104	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   105	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   106	
   107	/-- The group-object structure on the representing object, via mathlib's
   108	`GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy` — this is the (definitional) discharge route of the frozen
   109	`Jacobian.instGrpObj`.  Not a global instance here (the datum is a section variable);
   110	activate per proof with `letI := d.grpObj` or
   111	`attribute [local instance] JacobianData.grpObj`. -/
   112	@[implicit_reducible]
   113	noncomputable def grpObj (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj d.J :=
   114	  GrpObj.ofRepresentableBy d.J (pic0Functor C ⋙ forget₂ CommGrpCat GrpCat) d.rep
   115	
   116	/-- **The universal property, consumer form**: morphisms into `d.J` are degree-zero
   117	étale Picard classes.  This accessor owns the `forget₂ ⋙ forget` defeq massage once:
   118	the target is the honest subgroup carrier `pic0Subgroup C T`. -/
   119	def homEquiv (d : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} :
   120	    (T ⟶ d.J) ≃ pic0Subgroup C T :=
   121	  d.rep.homEquiv
   122	
   123	/-- Naturality of `homEquiv` against the degree-zero restriction maps `pic0Map`
   124	(element form of the `RepresentableBy` naturality, with the functor value unfolded
   125	through `forget₂ ⋙ forget`). -/
   126	theorem homEquiv_comp (d : JacobianData C) {T T' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   127	    (f : T' ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ d.J) :
   128	    d.homEquiv (f ≫ g) = pic0Map C f (d.homEquiv g) :=
   129	  d.rep.homEquiv_comp f g
   130	
   131	/-- Representing objects are unique up to isomorphism (mathlib
   132	`Functor.RepresentableBy.uniqueUpToIso`): any two Jacobian data for the same curve have
   133	canonically isomorphic `J`.  This is Wave-7's `baseChangeIso` mechanism. -/
   134	noncomputable def uniqueUpToIso (d d' : JacobianData C) : d.J ≅ d'.J :=
   135	  d.rep.uniqueUpToIso d'.rep
   136	
   137	/-- The intertwining property of `uniqueUpToIso`: composing with the canonical
   138	isomorphism commutes with the two universal properties. -/
   139	theorem homEquiv_uniqueUpToIso_hom (d d' : JacobianData C) {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   140	    (f : T ⟶ d.J) :
   141	    d'.homEquiv (f ≫ (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom) = d.homEquiv f := by
   142	  have h : (d.uniqueUpToIso d').hom = d'.rep.homEquiv.symm (d.rep.homEquiv (𝟙 d.J)) := rfl
   143	  rw [homEquiv, homEquiv, h, Functor.RepresentableBy.comp_homEquiv_symm]
   144	  exact (d'.rep.homEquiv.apply_symm_apply _).trans (d.rep.homEquiv_eq f).symm
   145	
   146	end JacobianData
   147	
   148	/-! ## η-defeq smoke tests (recon §5 lower-order unknown; `example`-level, nothing
   149	registered)
   150	
   151	The first test records that `Over.mk d.J.hom ≡ d.J` definitionally (structure eta); the
   152	second that instance resolution crosses it — `smooth_of_grpObj`'s hypothesis
   153	`[GrpObj (Over.mk f)]` at `f := d.J.hom` is discharged by `letI := d.grpObj`; the third
   154	that mathlib's `IsClosedImmersion η[d.J].left` instance fires on `d.J` as-is.  T-chain
   155	and S2 depend on these; if a mathlib bump ever breaks them, a transport lemma must be
   156	added HERE, not in the consumers. -/
   157	
   158	section EtaDefeqSmokeTests
   159	
   160	open MonObj
   161	
   162	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   163	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   164	
   165	/-- Smoke test 1: `Over.mk d.J.hom` is definitionally `d.J` — the ascription
   166	elaborates with no transport. -/
   167	noncomputable example (d : JacobianData C) : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj
   168	
   169	/-- Smoke test 2: `smooth_of_grpObj` applies to `d.J.hom` with no transport lemma;
   170	the group instance must be *keyed* at `Over.mk d.J.hom` (the ascribed `letI` below —
   171	instance search does not unfold `Over.mk` on its own, but the ascription is pure
   172	defeq). -/
   173	example (d : JacobianData C) [GeometricallyReduced d.J.hom] : Smooth d.J.hom :=
   174	  letI := d.locallyOfFiniteType
   175	  letI : GrpObj (Over.mk d.J.hom) := d.grpObj
   176	  smooth_of_grpObj d.J.hom
   177	
   178	/-- Smoke test 3: the unit section of `d.J` is a closed immersion (mathlib's
   179	group-scheme instance fires on `d.J` directly, with the datum's group structure in
   180	scope). -/
   181	example (d : JacobianData C) [GrpObj d.J] : IsClosedImmersion η[d.J].left :=
   182	  inferInstance
   183	
   184	end EtaDefeqSmokeTests

   186	end AlgebraicGeometry
